name: Hot Chef's Prize
source:
Late nights at the office have brought you more than just work. Your boss, the CEO, cannot stop himself from giving in to his feelings for you! But a golden opportunity might bring a new man in front of you! Are you ready to taste the passion?

[From in-app]
